A biological anomaly, whose difference from the rest of humanity could be hidden only for so long. However strong dylan lokensgard's yearning to fit in, to win acceptance, to love and to be loved he could not defeat the unseen forces which direct behavior. In the struggle between our desire to determine who and what we will be and the identity which biology defines for us there can only be one outcome.
